questions.prompt: Which of these are types of pasta?
questions.fact: Farfalle means butterflies in Italian, and fusilli comes from the word for a spindle.

questions.prompt: Which of these are birds of prey?
questions.fact: A kestrel can hang still in the air against the wind while it watches the grass for mice.

questions.prompt: How many minutes does a rugby union match last, not counting stoppages?
questions.fact: Two halves of 40 minutes, and the ball has to go dead before the referee can end a half.

questions.prompt: How old was Alexander the Great when he died?
questions.fact: 32, and by then he ruled an empire stretching from Greece to what is now Pakistan.

questions.prompt: Which part of the eye controls how much light gets in?
questions.fact: The iris is a ring of muscle that opens and closes the pupil like a camera shutter.

questions.prompt: What is a male bee called?
questions.hint: It is also a word for a flying robot.
questions.fact: Drones do no work in the hive. Their only job is to mate with a queen.
